title: Felixs OrbitalStrike
description: This is my own datapack i made in a few hours it features Orbital stab and nuke shots.
body:
This is my own Orbital Strike Cannon Datapack that includes:
-Stab Shots
-Nuke Shots
-Custom Broadcasted sounds when a nuke/stab is pulled.
Commands for the orbitals are:
 Nuke: /give <YourName> fishing_rod[damage=63,item_name=Nuke] 1
 Stab: /give <YourName> fishing_rod[minecraft:damage=62,minecraft:item_name=Stab] 1
 Deffinetly send feedpack so i can make the Datapack better.
